questions.question: What is the difference between the compound interest on ₹40,000 at 20% per annum compounded half - yearly and compounded quarterly for a period of one year ?
questions.solution:
Calculation of compound interest for half-yearly CI₁ = P(1 + r₁/100)²ⁿ - P

Calculation of compound interest for quarterly of year CI₂ = P(1 + r₂/100)⁴ⁿ - P

Given :

Principle = 40,000

Rate of interest = 20%

∴ r₁ for half-yearly = 10%

∴ r₂ for quarterly of year = 5%

⇒ n = 1 year

Difference between the compound interest on ₹40,000 at 20% per annum compounded half - yearly and compounded quarterly for a period of one year is :

⇒ CI₁ -CI₂ = [P(1 + r1/100)2n - P] - [P(1 + r2/100)4n - P]

⇒ P(1 + 10/100)² - P - P(1 + 5/100)⁴ + P

⇒ P(1 + 1/10)² - P(1 + 1/20)⁴

= 40000(11/10)² - 40000(21/20)⁴

= 40000[(11/10)² - (21/20)⁴]

or

= 40000 [(21/20)⁴ - (11/10)²]

= 40000(1.05⁴ - 1.1²)

= 40000(1.21550625 - 1.21)

= 40000 (0.00550625)

**= 220.25**

Hence, the correct answer is **"₹ 220.25".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

T _ D S _ R _ S T R D _ T _ D S _ R _ S

options.text: R, T, D, T, R, D, T
D, T, D, S, S, S, T
R, T, D, S, R, T, D
D, T, R, S, R, T, D

questions.solution:
Given :- T _ D S _ R _ S T R D _ T _ D S _ R _ S

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1. R, T, D, T, R, D, T → T **R** D S - **T** R **D** S - T R D **T** - T **R** D S - **D** R **T** S

2. D, T, D, S, S, S, T → T **D** D S - **T** R **D** S - T R D **S** - T **S** D S - **S** R **T** S

**3. R, T, D, S, R, T, D →** T **R** D S - **T** R **D** S - T R D **S** - T **R** D S - **T** R **D** S

 
• Here TRDS is repeated.

4. D, T, R, S, R, T, D → T **D** D S - **T** R **R** S - T R D **S** - T **R** D S - **T** R **D** S

 
• Option (3) gives a pattern of : T R **D S** - T R D S - T R D S - T R D S - T **R** D **S**

Hence, the correct answer is **"R, T, D, S, R, T, D".**

questions.question:
If 'P' denotes 'addition', 'D' denotes 'subtraction', 'S' denotes 'multiplication', and 'V' denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following expression ?

15 S 2 P 2 (11 S 2) D 75 V 15 D 4 (9 S 4)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2555e1fbd7e94a37a581b4361ea54c0cb4a6e8721cbd21866be29e0fa1c4629.png] 

Given :

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 **Symbol**
 
 

 P
 +
 
 

 D
 -
 
 

 S
 × 
 
 

 V
 ÷ 
 
 

 

Given equation is : 15 S 2 P 2 (11 S 2) D 75 V 15 D 4 (9 S 4)

By inserting the symbols in given equation the expression is as follows : 

= 15 × 2 + 2 (__**11 × 2**__) - 75 ÷ 15 - 4 (**__9 ×__****__ 4__**)

= 15 × 2 + __**2 (22)**__ - 75 ÷ 15 - **4 (36****)**

= 15 × 2 + 44 - __**75 ÷ 15**__ - 144

= **__15 × 2__** + 44 - 5 - 144

​= __**30 + 44**__ - 5 - 144

= __**74 - 149**__

**= -75**

Hence, the correct answer is **"-75".**

questions.solution:

**First number²** **+ 6 = Second number**

 ♦ 15 : 231 → 15² + 6 = 225 + 6 = 231

Similarly,

 ♦ ** 16 : ? → 16² + 6 = 256 + 6 = 262**

Hence, the correct answer is **"262".**

3. 'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q'.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements : **

1. All flowers are tulips.

2. No tulips are whites.

**Conclusions :**

I. All tulips are flowers.

II. Some tulips are whites.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc07d06d28cfa0b1126d4d59d70f6da9ebdf44f38232550cef8a4f747026fb54.png] 

Conclusions :

I. All tulips are flowers → False (As All flowers are tulips so, All tulips are flowers, hence, False)

II. Some tulips are whites → False (As No tulips are whites so, Some tulips are whites, hence, False)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows".**
